title: Fuzzer: `GLTFNode.get_scene_node_path` crashes Godot
body:

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable219 = GLTFNode.new()
	temp_variable219.get_scene_node_path(null, false)

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29937875/mrp.zip)
